tasks.label: Inspect widget dependency counts
args: const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..');const ignore=new Set(['allOfMyProjects','azure','__pycache__','copy','trash','.git','node_modules','.next','build','dist','out','coverage']);function looks(p){try{return ['package.json','pyproject.toml','README.md','src','app','public'].some(x=>fs.readdirSync(p).includes(x))}catch{return false}}function walk(p){return fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(e=>e.isDirectory()&&!ignore.has(e.name)&&!e.name.startsWith('.')).flatMap(e=>{const f=path.join(p,e.name);const file=path.join(f,'package.json');let j=null;try{if(fs.existsSync(file))j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'))}catch{}const s=j?.scripts||{};if(looks(f)&&(!j||['dev','start','build'].some(x=>typeof s[x]==='string')))return[{folder:path.relative(root,f),name:j?.name||path.relative(root,f),deps:Object.keys(j?.dependencies||{}).length,devDeps:Object.keys(j?.devDependencies||{}).length,modules:fs.existsSync(path.join(f,'node_modules')),scripts:Object.keys(s),mgr:j?.packageManager||'',lock:['package-lock.json','npm-shrinkwrap.json','pnpm-lock.yaml','yarn.lock','bun.lock','bun.lockb'].filter(x=>fs.existsSync(path.join(f,x))).join(',')}];return walk(f)})}console.log(JSON.stringify(walk(root).sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),null,2))

tasks.label: Run last dashboard widgets
args: const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const base="http://127.0.0.1:3000",root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),"..");const widgets=["EarthJS","BurgerWebsite\\bangkok-clone","BurgerWebsite\\burger-app-gmn"];(async()=>{for(const folder of widgets){const full=path.resolve(root,folder),pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(full,"package.json"),"utf8")),id=folder.split(path.sep).map(s=>s.toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g,"-")).join("--"),count=Object.keys(pkg.dependencies||{}).length;console.log("START "+folder+" ["+count+" dependencies]");try{let r=await fetch(base+"/api/server",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"start",projectId:id,folderPath:full})}),state=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(state.error||"start request failed "+r.status);for(let i=0;i<190&&["installing","starting"].includes(state.status);i++){await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,1000));r=await fetch(base+"/api/server?projectId="+encodeURIComponent(id));state=await r.json()}console.log("RESULT "+JSON.stringify({folder,status:state.status,url:state.url,error:state.error,logs:(state.logs||[]).slice(-12)}));if(state.status==="ready"){const probe=await fetch(state.url,{redirect:"manual",signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});console.log("HTTP "+probe.status+" "+probe.headers.get("content-type"));await fetch(base+"/api/server",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"stop",projectId:id})})}else{await fetch(base+"/api/server",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"stop",projectId:id})})}}catch(e){console.log("FAILED "+folder+": "+e.message);try{await fetch(base+"/api/server",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"stop",projectId:id})})}catch{}}if(count===10){console.log("STOPPING at the 10-dependency widget, as requested.");break}}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1})
